question: Does LM-polishing the top-5 s057h cluster representatives (plus the truth cluster) convert cloud-data forward-prop seeds into Band A basins on seed 89?
hypothesis: The cloud-data forward-propagation architecture is operational as a seed generator: LM polish of its cluster reps lands Band A basins on a multi-solution-rich seed.

artefacts.caption: LM polish of cluster reps: seed vs polished rho, seed 89

narrative_md: On seed 89, LM-polished top-5 cluster reps PLUS the truth cluster (looked up by cluster_id) from s057h; 2/6 polishes land Band A -- the truth cluster (rank 107/325, rho 0.18, q0_err 0.86 deg) and a body-twin-direction cluster (rho 0.17, q0_err 179.5 deg). Writeup framing: architecture PASSES the seed-generator gate. CAVEAT (later retracted as oracle-tainted): the Band-A rows include the injected truth cluster, so the headline yield is not blind -- oracle-leak, N=1.
